about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Your Trusted Candy Manufacturing Partner
about.team_subtitle: The experienced professionals behind our success
about.story_p1: Founded in 2008, CandyPro began as a small family-owned candy factory with a simple mission: to create delicious, high-quality confectionery products that bring joy to people of all ages.
about.story_p2: Over the years, we have grown from a local manufacturer to a trusted OEM partner for brands around the world. Today, our 20,000 square meter facility produces over 100 tons of candy daily, serving clients in more than 50 countries across Europe, the Americas, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East.
about.story_p3: What sets us apart is our commitment to quality and innovation. We invest heavily in R&D, continuously improving our formulations and processes to meet the evolving needs of our clients. Our state-of-the-art production lines and rigorous quality control systems ensure that every product that leaves our facility meets the highest standards.
about.mission_desc: To be the most trusted OEM candy manufacturing partner for global brands, delivering exceptional quality, innovation, and service that helps our clients succeed in their markets.
about.vision_desc: To become the leading candy manufacturer in Asia, known for product excellence, operational efficiency, and sustainable practices that set industry benchmarks.
about.values_desc: Quality, Integrity, Innovation, Partnership, Sustainability – these core values guide everything we do, from product development to customer service.
